notes: toshiba.semicon-storage.com blocks curl's 'Mozilla/5.0' user agent (Akamai 'Access Denied') but serves PDFs and product pages to 'Wget/1.21'.

None of these Toshiba datasheets contain ordering information. (LF1) surface-mount lead-form rows were added only where a distributor listing confirms the orderable number: TLP222A (TP1 taped LF1), TLP222A-2, TLP3544, TLP3545. Toshiba product pages for TLP3542/TLP3543/TLP3546 also say 'Through Hole/Surface Mount', so (LF1) probably exists for them too, but no orderable listing was found, so they were left out. No (LF5)/(LF4)/(LF2) listings were found for any of these parts.

Lifecycle: 'EOL announced' (TLP3123, TLP3542-TLP3546) and 'Not Recommended for New Design' (TLP175A) are both mapped to NRND. TLP222A and TLP222A-2 product pages are gone from Toshiba's site, so they are recorded as Obsolete.
TLP222A/TLP222A-2 datasheet is the 2017-07-10 revision, taken from an LCSC mirror of the Toshiba PDF; the newer Jun-2019 Toshiba revision could not be retrieved.
Packing codes (TP, TP1, TPL, TPR, etc.) and the VDE option (V4) are not separate rows.
